Try it free on your roster

01What you get every Wednesday

  • every slot decided from your whole roster, up to 40 players
  • each close call naming the bench player and the points gap
  • players getting more of the ball lately, yours first
  • an if/then for questionable starters
  • the Saturday check, only if Friday's injury report changes your lineup
  • every bye ahead checked through the playoffs

Rookies can start. Their odds wait until they have enough games on record, and the row says so.

02Set it up for your league

  1. Copy your roster from any app, or type each name into “Add a player”. Paste it into the roster box. Extra text rides along fine.
  2. More than 40 players? Leave out your IR and taxi players.
  3. Dynasty is already picked. In a keeper league, choose Keeper.
  4. Pick your lineup: Superflex, Two FLEX, Three WR or Standard, with or without a K and a DEF.
  5. Pick your scoring and league size: full PPR, half PPR or standard, in a league of 8, 10, 12 or 14 teams.
StandardQB · 2 RB · 2 WR · TE · FLEX · K · DEFTwo FLEXQB · 2 RB · 2 WR · TE · 2 FLEX · K · DEFThree WRQB · 2 RB · 3 WR · TE · FLEX · K · DEFSuperflexStandard plus a second flex that can take a QB

TE premium and six-point passing touchdowns aren't scored yet. Pick the closest.

03What it doesn't do

It sets up this week's lineup. It doesn't value trades, rank rookies or help with your startup or rookie draft. It uses the same weekly model as every league, so it isn't tuned for dynasty. Weekly reports run during the NFL season, not the off-season.

It doesn't connect to your league or set your lineup there. You make the moves. Roster changed? Update it from the link in any report, or reply with it.

Get my lineupsSee a real report

In redraft, keeper and dynasty leagues? One plan covers up to 3 teams.

Weighing a trade? Your plan's Trade Check shows what it does to this week's lineup and your byes. It doesn't say what the players are worth long term.

After the NFL Draft, plan members can ask for the rookie report: every new QB, RB, WR and TE, where he landed and who landed beside your players. See the rookie report.

Everyone in your league in? The League Pass gives every manager their own report.
